rationale: Reactive current iq = k*(deadband - V) for V below 0.9 pu, clipped to 1.2 pu. Active current id = min(prefault 0.92, sqrt(limit^2 - iq^2)) after reactive priority. Total = sqrt(id^2+iq^2). All sample voltages remain above the 0.45 pu floor and below-floor duration is zero (< 0.2 s), and the reactive-current requirement is met at every sample, so FRT is compliant.
